nextGame.note: Sunday noon kickoff in the Superdome. Minnesota has won all four of its games.

news.headline: Three Saints are ruled out for Sunday
news.summary: Kaden Elliss, Anfernee Jennings and Jeremiah Wright will not play against Minnesota. Alvin Kamara practiced again Friday and is still a maybe, while Tyler Shough has no injury tag at all and is clear to play.

news.headline: Drew Brees joins the Ring of Honor on Sunday
news.summary: The Saints will honor Drew Brees at halftime of Sunday's game in the Superdome. He gets his Hall of Fame ring and becomes the ninth man in the team's Ring of Honor, and fans walking in get a Brees banner.

news.headline: Chris Olave is set to play Sunday
news.summary: ESPN's Saints reporter says receiver Chris Olave is good to go against Minnesota. He was limited in practice this week with a sore foot.

nextGame.note: Late morning kickoff. It is homecoming at Florida.

news.headline: South Carolina beats Florida 38-19 at home
news.summary: South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers threw four touchdown passes and ran for another in Gainesville on Saturday. It is Florida's second lopsided loss in a row, and the home crowd booed coach Jon Sumrall.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is still a question mark for Saturday
news.summary: Florida's leading receiver hurt his knee and sat out the Missouri game. This week's team report lists him as questionable for South Carolina.

news.headline: Sumrall says South Carolina has the most talent yet
news.summary: Coach Jon Sumrall said South Carolina is the best group of players Florida has faced this year, even though the Gamecocks have lost three games. They come to Florida on Saturday for homecoming.

news.headline: LSU will be without five players at Kentucky
news.summary: Linebacker Whit Weeks and tight end Trey'Dez Green are among the five Tigers ruled out for Saturday. Quarterback Sam Leavitt is not on the injury list at all.

news.headline: Sam Leavitt says he will be ready on Saturday
news.summary: The LSU quarterback told reporters Tuesday that his sore hamstring feels really good and he will be 100 percent by Saturday. He played through it the last two games.

news.headline: Green and Weeks could play again this season
news.summary: Coach Lane Kiffin said tight end Trey'Dez Green has his knee brace off and is getting closer, but will miss a third straight game on Saturday. Linebacker Whit Weeks had surgery on a broken leg and has a chance to come back late in the year.

nextGame.note: Saturday morning kickoff at West Point.

news.headline: Army beats Tulane 20-17 on the last play
news.summary: Army kicked a field goal as time ran out at West Point on Saturday. Tulane had tied the game late on a 39-yard touchdown pass from Kadin Semonza to Jaylin Lucas, and hosts Memphis next Friday night.

news.headline: Jamauri McClure is back for the Army game
news.summary: McClure hurt his left foot in August and has not played all season. Tulane expects its best running back on the field Saturday at Army.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.
